pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, sub-polygonal patches with rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. The patches represent high spatial area density relative to the inter-patch spacing.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space graph of light-colored pelage forming a reticulated network. Nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pixel thickness of the pathways is narrow and relatively uniform across the visible mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the mane line, extending from the upper neck to the shoulder ridge.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized thinning or structural break in the mane line is visible at the transition point between the cervical and thoracic dorsal segments.
